BiblicalUsage: The word ʼumnâm is the Bible's way of saying truly, verily. In Genesis 18:13, Shall I of a surety bear a child, and it appears again in Numbers 22:37.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that God put ʼumnâm exactly where it is, and I trust His placing of it.
